summary_en: The study tests INBRX-106 given together with pembrolizumab, before the main treatment, in people with stage II or III triple negative breast cancer. Both drugs are given by IV infusion: pembrolizumab at 200 mg and INBRX-106 at 0.1 mg/kg, every 3 weeks; the total length of treatment is not stated. The record says the study is a Phase II trial to assess efficacy and feasibility, but a specific main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa INBRX-106 administrado junto con pembrolizumab, antes del tratamiento principal, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo en estadio II o III. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa: pembrolizumab a 200 mg e INBRX-106 a 0.1 mg/kg, cada 3 semanas; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El registro dice que el estudio es de Fase II para evaluar la eficacia y la factibilidad, pero no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Histologically confirmed HER2-negative triple negative breast cancer; ER/PR up to 10% allowed.
Primary breast tumor measurable by ultrasound and at least 1 cm.
Clinically appropriate for neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy with curative intent; no prior TNBC therapy; sTIL score at least 1%.
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or other T-cell stimulatory agent such as OX40, CTLA-4 or CD137 (some exceptions for other cancers).
Known HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or active tuberculosis.
